bukti: we propose FruitGaussian, a novel 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based framework for high-fidelity orchard scene understanding and fruit counting
Evaluations on real-world persimmon orchard datasets demonstrate a 96 % counting accuracy, surpassing Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF)-based methods by 16 %.

c1.hasil_ringkas: Pipeline menghasilkan 9.739 landmark apel terhadap 9.985 apel hasil panen (selisih 246, kurang hitung 2,46%); galat per baris 3,20% sampai 30,77%. CoTracker3 mencapai HOTA 42,63% dan IDF1 50,75%.

bukti: Apples are detected using a YOLO-based model and associated across frames via CoTracker3, enabling robust multi-view landmark reconstruction.
The pipeline produced Npred = 9739 landmarks versus NGT = 9985 apples, corresponding to an absolute error of 246 apples and an aggregate undercount of 2.46%.
The ground-truth value is established by physically harvesting the scanned orchard block and manually counting all collected fruits
catatan: Satu track CoTracker3 menjadi satu landmark 3D; hitungan adalah jumlah landmark sah, sehingga penghapus duplikat utama adalah pelacakan (M3), sedangkan triangulasi dan iSAM2 (M4) menyaring dan memperhalus landmark tanpa menggabungkannya. CoTracker3 adalah pelacak titik terlatih, dikodekan M3. Naskah mengakui tidak ada re-identifikasi setelah putar balik dan potensi hitung ganda dari dua sisi baris belum dievaluasi. Metrik pelacakan dihitung terhadap anotasi (253 identitas GT).

bukti: we propose a novel framework for fruit 3D localization that leverages temporal associations between consecutive video frames, and employs a Recursive Least Squares (RLS) estimator
This approach enables robust and precise position tracking of individual fruits, facilitating both non-invasive yield prediction and targeted harvesting operations.

bukti: To combine sequences of acquired point clouds, we utilize a real-time 3D mapping framework and build up a fruit map based on truncated signed distance fields.

we extract clusters to identify individual fruits. We utilize Euclidean cluster extraction with a cluster tolerance of 0.01 m
